comment: Hand-authored ideal projections for the captured tour conversation (tour_overview.json). Each case names one dialogue turn (= one probe shape), what the recorded projection actually did (observed_today, from the captured events), and what a correct provenance-adaptive projection must do (ideal). The TDD suite in tests/selection_replay.rs asserts the ideal against the exported sig fixture; cases marked failing_today are #[ignore]d red tests until docs/provenance_adaptive_projection.md lands.

cases.name: codebase_tour
cases.intent: Give me a tour of the codebase — main crates, key files, and how everything connects.

observed_today.outcome: model narrated the tools catalog + random scopes as the codebase

ideal.structure_notes: workspace-root cluster (tag ".") plus top-level crate clusters

observed_today.outcome: datetime tool selected and called correctly
calculator tool selected and called correctly (the answer's exponent error is model-level, not selection)

cases.name: modelbuilder_definition
cases.intent: tell me what the ModelBuilder struct does

observed_today.outcome: model answered 'no codebase context has been provided'

ideal.anchor_present: first exchange of the builder.rs conversation (file header: module doc + imports)

cases.name: self_recall
cases.intent: what questions did i ask during this conversation - list them

observed_today.outcome: model listed 4 of 5 questions, dropping the tour question; irrelevant scopes diluted dialogue attention

ideal.code_mass_low: a history question carries no code attention; adaptive budget should shrink the scopes share toward its floor
